newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EESTI KINDLUSTUS JULY PREMIUMS 23.3 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: EESTI KINDLUSTUS JULY PREMIUMS 23.3 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Eesti Kindlustus group, the insurance arm of the Hoiupank group, said on Wednesday that collected premiums in July reached a record level of 23.3 million kroons.
The group's total collected premiums for July was an increase of 43 percent compared to the previous year, the insurance group said in a statement.
In July the group's life insurance company collected premiums worth 4.6 million kroons, which was 65 percent of the previous year's income.
The property insurance arm of the group collected 10.1 million kroons from compulsory traffic insurance and general property insurance raised 8.6 million kroons.
